timer-remedy-doc-cz-dd-2026-09-13-ks-ksz.title: Brno Regional Court / Brno Regional and Olomouc High Public Prosecutor’s Offices – supplement to complaints and supervisory filings
timer-remedy-doc-cz-dd-2026-09-13-ks-ksz.event: The filing of 13 September 2026 supplemented complaint proceedings 9 To 315/2026 and 9 To 316/2026 and related supervision/review branches before the Olomouc High and Brno Regional Public Prosecutor’s Offices.

timer-remedy-doc-cz-dd-2026-09-13-nsz-ct.event: The closing communication of 13 September 2026 followed the pre-action demand to the Supreme Public Prosecutor’s Office and the continuing complaint to Czech Television and its Council; it identified the 11 September article and Ministry/Accreditation filing as new records.
